healthCheck.note: Polling bridge has NO callback URL by design — health is heartbeat freshness + lastPollOk, NOT callback registration. EClaw passive-health must exempt this channelType from the no-callback check (see selfheal/LAYER2-eclaw-backend-proposal.md in claude-code-eclaw-channel).

bindVerify.note: Codex bridge re-binds via .data/state.json on startup (no /api/channel/bind). 'bind' verify = a successful authenticated poll of /api/chat/history.

description: Repo-bound, version-aware self-repair program for the #6 Codex polling bridge. Contract: detect-latest -> auto-install-latest -> repair (restart poller+watchdog) -> health-verify (heartbeat fresh) -> poll sync-verify.
